issue.title: Footprint: a local usage census for finding what sase should delete
issue.description: sase keeps an always-on, privacy-by-construction census of which of its surfaces (CLI commands and options, TUI actions and keys, views and modals, macros, skills, config leaves, automation) are used, by whom, and how. The census costs at most one appended line per CLI process and one in-memory counter bump per TUI action. A Statistics → Footprint view and a `sase footprint` command turn it into a review workflow that ends in keep reasons and deletion task beads. The local data contains only allowlisted IDs and enum values, so it can later be exported, and export packs carry no identity.
